summary: Verified the new full-width mobile bottom status bar and the non-blocking taunt / graceful-skip cutscene wiring for Bust'a'Lead. MOBILE (390x844): mobile-g2-bar renders fixed edge-to-edge at the very bottom (x=0, w=390, y=803, h=41, bottom=844), z-index=50, shows 'G2 / D / $100.00', and does NOT overlap player-hand (hand bottom=788, bar top=803, 15px gap). Cards remain tappable (clicked a card, no interception). DESKTOP (1920x800): mobile-g2-bar is absent, seat-books-P dock is present — non-regression OK. GAME LOOP: played 5 hands end-to-end (hard difficulty, fast speed). Every hand reached the SettlementModal within seconds. No cutscene ever hung; the existing 'hand-concede' cutscene rendered and dismissed cleanly. Non-blocking taunt-doolow_bid was observed to render during the auction (visible taunt-* testid) while the auction continued to completion (PapaCap took contract at $90) — proving the TauntLayer does NOT freeze the game loop. Zero uncaught console errors and zero 404s captured on taunt/cutscene asset names during the runs.
critical_code_review_comments: Table.jsx is ~1015 lines — approaching the 700-line split threshold. Consider extracting the mobile-g2-bar and desktop dock into their own components for maintainability.
In useGame.js, the non-blocking-taunt useEffect on state.bidLog fires correctly and clears without blocking; verified end-to-end. No changes needed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Mobile bar: data-testid='mobile-g2-bar', fixed inset-x-0 bottom-0 z-50 border-t, full 390px wide at bottom on 390x844. player-hand mobile branch at fixed inset-x-0 bottom-14 z-30 — 15px gap above bar. TauntLayer testid pattern 'taunt-<key>' (saw taunt-doolow_bid). Blocking cutscene testid 'cutscene-overlay' — none observed to hang across 5 hands. To force AI-takes-contract path: hard difficulty, bid-60 base, human passes throughout (retry over multiple hands until AI outbids). settlement-modal shows within ~5 iterations at fast speed.
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found. All five review items pass: (1) mobile bar full-width edge-to-edge at bottom, (2) cards still tappable, (3) settlement reached with no cutscene hang, (4) non-blocking taunt does not freeze auction — proven by taunt-doolow_bid observed then game advanced to play phase, (5) desktop viewport does not render the mobile bar.
